en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a central square with a large statue of a robed man on a high pedestal, surrounded by historic multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows. In the background stands a crenellated tower. A lone man is visible near the monument. Printed caption at the top identifies the scene as Piazza Erbe with the Monument to Alessandro Vittoria in Trento, Italy. A handwritten date appears in the lower right corner.
